anchors.description: Vertical straight-line distance between the top and bottom corners of the open blue interior door's free vertical edge.
anchors.visible_evidence: Blue flat-panel door swung open at left; the top corner sits just under the white door casing and the bottom corner meets the hallway threshold, giving the full leaf face height.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Standard US residential interior door is 80 in (2.03 m) tall; a 78 in or 84 in leaf in an older home would shift this by ~5 percent.

anchors.description: Vertical straight-line distance from the bottle cap to the base of the dark glass bottle standing on the bottom shelf board.
anchors.visible_evidence: Tall dark-glass bottle with a narrow neck, long body and foil-style cap among three similar bottles on the bottom shelf; proportions (height ~4x body width) match a standard 750 ml wine bottle.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Could be 375 ml (about 24 cm) or 1.5 L (about 35 cm) wine, or a tall condiment bottle; the three-bottle cluster and green/dark glass favor 750 ml.

anchors.description: Horizontal straight-line distance across the front of the black and silver rice cooker between its left and right outer body edges.
anchors.visible_evidence: Cylindrical black body with brushed-metal lid and front control panel, sitting on the bottom shelf next to the bottles; outer width spans about 63 px, consistent with a 5.5-10 cup rice cooker under the shelf's depth scale.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Could be a rice cooker, water boiler or bread maker; 5.5-10 cup models are 25-30 cm wide, but compact models may be narrower.
